summary: Tested CAPTCHA + contact flow end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (GET /api/captcha shape, two unique IDs, correct answer succeeds (200/received), wrong answer => 400 Captcha failed, replay of same captcha_id => 400, missing captcha fields => 422). Frontend: on /contact the captcha question, refresh button, and answer input all render with proper data-testids. Refresh loads a new question. Empty captcha blocks submission and shows 'Please solve the captcha.' validation error. Submitting with the correctly computed answer shows contact-success-card and 'Send another enquiry' button; toast 'Enquiry received' confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: In-memory _CAPTCHAS dict means captchas are lost on backend restart and will not work across multiple backend replicas; acceptable for single-process self-hosted but should be documented or moved to DB/Redis if horizontally scaled.
Captcha difficulty is low (single-digit a+b, answers 2..18) — easily brute-forced; consider wider range or add simple rate limiting on /api/contact.
No rate limit on /api/captcha could allow enumeration; low risk given single-use TTL.
seed_data_creation: Submitted a couple of TEST_ contact messages via /api/contact during testing (only created, no deletions performed). These are owner-visible via admin enquiries list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Captcha is math-based (single-digit a+b). To submit via browser, parse 'What is X + Y?' from data-testid=captcha-question and enter X+Y into contact-captcha-input. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_captcha_contact.py.
